fallback: MuseMind rule-based engine is used if the pretrained model fails; non-English journal text is currently rejected rather than analyzed.

product_features.reflection_support: Rule-based Thought Decoder using saved text, emotion signals, sentence analysis and detected context categories
product_features.personal_memory: Local keyword matching across the current user's journal entries; no semantic embedding or external LLM retrieval
product_features.growth_support: Optional rule-based suggestions and user-managed action list
product_features.voice_input: Browser Web Speech API where supported

storage: Browser localStorage; no backend or secure server-side authentication in this prototype
limitations: Non-English journal text is currently rejected; the rule-based fallback is for model failure, not Hindi/Hinglish support.
The model is pretrained/fine-tuned and is not trained by MuseMind
Emotion predictions are signals, not facts or clinical assessments
Thought Decoder and Growth Studio use local rules, not an LLM API
Memory Mirror uses keyword matching, not semantic search
Voice input depends on browser/device support and speech service behaviour

musemind_updates.time_of_day_insights: Counts the user-selected time period across that user’s own saved entries. It does not infer a universal preferred journaling time.
musemind_updates.human_feedback: Users may correct the predicted GoEmotions label on saved entries. Corrections are stored locally and included in exports; they do not automatically train the deployed model.
musemind_updates.training_pipeline: See training/finetune_musemind.py. This is a reproducible fine-tuning pipeline; no MuseMind-specific model weights have been trained or evaluated yet.
